baselineRegression.method: Identical final tests against an isolated turn-start LegalHub copy; dependencies from current working tree. Eleven parameterized failures are not eleven independent defects.

assertionFollowUp.reason: Two text selectors broadened to match both old and new formatting; substantive baseline failures now reach behavior assertions.

diffCheck: passed with repository CRLF whitespace settings
changes: Citation verification and judgment import use the existing document lifecycle and two-pane layout; removed independent state/reset/request/formatting paths.
Knowledge sync uses the existing lifecycle and apiJson; confirms a nonempty article ID before success events, rejects business failure and empty responses.
Late results cannot archive into another case or notify a closed account/organization view. Draft metadata/language refresh remains separate from case identity changes.
Failed results are not marked ready or offered for manual archive. Removed unconditional case-archive success claims from verification/import while retaining the actual material writes.
Error color is derived from successful result state rather than matching error-message words.
preserved: Knowledge article title/content/category/tags/status and successful knowledge/client-state events.
Citation verification still offers manual archive in both personal and organization scope: the server tool does not automatically persist a case material.
Judgment import retains its separate case-material write; the server tool creates a knowledge article and index, not that case material.
Existing backend legal permissions, organization ACLs, endpoint payloads, personal storage format and real user data unchanged.
limitations: Component network is mocked; backend regression tests use isolated HTTP/database fixtures. No native-client, visual screenshot or real-model acceptance.

No complete-suite rerun or backend rebuild for this frontend-only batch. Business source exactly matches the build input; only two test text selectors changed afterward and all 119 related tests were rerun.
Frontend cancellation cannot roll back server-side article/index creation or completed writes.
Case material callbacks still use parent optimistic persistence; removing a premature success message does not solve concurrent edit ordering, rollback or backend transaction atomicity.
Citation/import layouts now share packet/research widths and breakpoints; no pixel-identical claim.
No commit, push or client restart.
nextCandidates: LegalCaseWorkspace notice, engagement, reasoning and delivery actions retain repeated request lifecycle and optimistic archive confirmation.
Same-case write ordering/rollback, legacy personal storage account isolation and cross-entry model endpoint persistence remain open.
